primary_selection_metric: mean validation AUC; AP and ACC break ties

replication.reason: Top two modern linear candidates on seed-1 validation plus original and input-normalization GRU controls; original concat retained after feature ablations

shared_controls.evaluation: reset memory, replay full prefix with frozen checkpoint weights, then evaluate current split

heldout_policy: Lock selected configuration and comparison checkpoint paths from validation before evaluating test; do not tune after test. Report all locked comparisons regardless of their test ranking.

convergence_confirmation.trigger: If the strongest validation configuration peaks at the 24-epoch cap or still rises near the cap
convergence_confirmation.candidates: Original GRU reference; minGRU BPTT1 (best 3-seed default linear recurrence); LRU BPTT4 (best refinement on validation). Promote normalized GRU as another control if its replication mean exceeds original GRU.
convergence_confirmation.selection: Validation mean AUC then AP then ACC; no test metrics
convergence_confirmation.event_backend: wave for every arm; preserves independent-event update rules, numerical parity verified
convergence_confirmation.normalized_gru_reason: Completed 3-seed replication validation mean AUC was below original GRU; no test metrics used
